content:
Last month, Anthropic announced the expansion of Claude Cowork from Mac to iPhone and iPad. This rollout initially began with Anthropic's most expensive paid plan.

As of today, Anthropic stated that Claude Cowork has been fully rolled out to mobile and desktop versions across all paid plans.

You can learn more about the release of Anthropic Claude Cowork for mobile here.

Meanwhile, OpenAI has also launched its own solution called ChatGPT Work, which is likewise available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.

Make the most of your Apple products.
